strategy: progressive disclosure: load the smallest hot path first, then open deferred files only when the trigger applies

procedure: read the active phase from loop-state.json
open the target phase file and only its PRIMARY_CONTEXT

actor.primary_context_policy: open at most the four PRIMARY_CONTEXT entries listed by the active phase before planning

critic.review_policy: independent critic checks changed files, command evidence, browser evidence, minimal-change scope, and oracle status

planner.use_policy: planner files are opened for scope changes, blocker triage, or phase-map updates

deferred.README.md: do not load unless the harness intent or loading protocol is unclear
deferred.phase-manifest.md: do not load unless the target phase is unknown or dependency order is disputed
deferred.source-packet.md: do not load unless repository evidence, assumptions, browser/subagent evidence, or code-summary writeback is needed
deferred.loop-contract.json: do not load unless loop semantics are unclear
deferred.feature-oracle.json: do not load unless selecting or updating the active feature item
deferred.progress-log.md: do not load unless recent session status or blockers are needed
deferred.agent-handoff.md: do not load unless next action or role handoff is unclear
deferred.continuity-ledger.md: do not load unless dependency, interface, or code-summary writeback is needed
deferred.next-window-prompt.md: do not load unless preparing a fresh-window continuation prompt
deferred.reports/: do not load unless validating a dependency, completion claim, or critic review
